title: 倒著念
question:
請輸入 5 個數字存進清單，再從最後一個到第一個，一行輸出一個。
提示：清單[1] 是第 1 個，清單[5] 是第 5 個。可以用一個變數 i 從 5 開始，每次減 1，輸出 清單[i]。

test_case.note: 第 5 個先輸出，第 1 個最後輸出
數字沒有排好順序也一樣倒過來

en.title: Backward
en.question:
Input 5 numbers into a list. Then output them from the last one to the first one. One number on each line.
Tip: list[1] is the first item. list[5] is the fifth item. Make a variable i. Start at 5. Each time, output list[i] and take 1 away from i.

test_case.note: Item 5 comes first. Item 1 comes last
The numbers are not in order. Just go backward
Some numbers are the same. There is a 0
